27100.meaning1: name of an area in Sri Lanka; Mihintale
27100.meaning2: name of a mountain in Sri Lanka, present Mihintale

27102.meaning2: tree that is an object of veneration, sacred tree

27104.meaningLit: for the purpose of paying respect to a shrine
27104.construction:
cetiya + vandana + attha + āya
cetiyavandanattha + āya

27106.meaning2: name of the people from Ceta

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhū cetiyesu viharanti sahajaniye.
tena kho pana samayena bhagavā parito parito janapadesu paricārake abbhatīte kālaṅ'kate upapattīsu byākaroti kāsikosalesu vajjimallesu cetivaṃsesu kurupañcālesu majjhasūrasenesu

27108.meaning2: name of the people from Ceta

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, aṅgānaṃ, magadhānaṃ, kāsīnaṃ, kosalānaṃ, vajjīnaṃ, mallānaṃ, cetīnaṃ, vaṅgānaṃ, kurūnaṃ, pañcālānaṃ, macchānaṃ, sūrasenānaṃ, assakānaṃ, avantīnaṃ, gandhārānaṃ, kambojānaṃ, aṭṭh'aṅgasamannāgatassa uposathassa etaṃ kalaṃ n'āgghati soḷasiṃ. taṃ kissa hetu?
sadevakassa lokassa, ete vo sukhasammatā, yattha c'ete nirujjhanti, taṃ nesaṃ dukkhasammataṃ.
no c'etaṃ chando jāyetha, na'y'idaṃ ussaheyya, no c'ete dhammā nijjhānaṃ khameyyuṃ, na'y'idaṃ chando jāyetha.
phuṭṭho, bhikkhave, vedeti, phuṭṭho ceteti, phuṭṭho sañjānāti. itth'ete'pi dhammā calā c'eva byathā ca aniccā vipariṇāmino aññathābhāvino.

27111.commentary: (VINa) bāhullāya cetetī'ti bāhulattāya ceteti kappeti pakappeti. (SNa) yañ'ca, bhikkhave, cetetī'ti yaṃ cetanaṃ ceteti, pavattetī'ti attho.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhu, paṇḍito mahāpañño n'ev'attabyābādhāya ceteti na parabyābādhāya ceteti na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti attahita-parahita-ubhayahita-sabbalokahitam'eva cintayamāno cinteti
asañcetanikaṃ, bhante, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto no mahāsāvajjaṃ paññapetī'ti. sace pana, gahapati, cetetī'ti? mahāsāvajjaṃ, bhante, hotī'ti.

27114.meaning1: barrenness of mind; unproductive state of mind

examples.text: yassa kassaci, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pañca cetokhilā appahīnā, pañca cetasovinibandhā asamucchinnā, so vat'imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissatī'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

tassa kāyikā'pi darathā pavaḍḍhanti, cetasikā'pi darathā pavaḍḍhanti, kāyikā'pi santāpā pavaḍḍhanti, cetasikā'pi santāpā pavaḍḍhanti, kāyikā'pi pariḷāhā pavaḍḍhanti, cetasikā'pi pariḷāhā pavaḍḍhanti. so kāyikadukkham'pi cetodukkham'pi paṭisaṃvedeti.

27120.meaning1: filled with mental suffering; anguished; tormented
27120.meaning2: filled with mental suffering; anguished; tormented

examples.text: idamāyasmato ānandassa vacanaṃ sutvā mallā ca mallaputtā ca mallasuṇisā ca mallapajāpatiyo ca aghāvino dummanā cetodukkhasamappitā app'ekacce kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinnapātaṃ papatanti, āvaṭṭanti vivaṭṭanti
tañ'ca kho sīlavato vadāmi no dussīlassa. ijjhat'āvuso, sīlavato cetopaṇidhi visuddhattā.

27122.meaning1: by means of mental inclination; due to one's wish

examples.text: santi, bhikkhu, sītavalāhakā nāma devā. tesaṃ yadā evaṃ hoti, yaṃnūna mayaṃ sakāya ratiyā vaseyyāmā'ti, tesaṃ taṃ cetopaṇidhim'anvāya sītaṃ hoti. ayaṃ kho, bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yen'ekadā sītaṃ hotī'ti.

27123.meaning1: because of mental corruption; due to bad mentality

examples.text: yathā haritvā nikkhipeyya, evam'eva tathāvidho, cetopadosahetu hi, sattā gacchanti duggatin'ti.

27124.meaning1: encompassing another's mind; knowing another's thoughts (with)
27124.commentary: (ANa) cetasā cetopariccā'ti attano cittena tassa cittaṃ paricchinditvā. (THIa) cetopariccañāṇañ'cā'ti cetopariyañāṇañ'ca visodhitan'ti sambandho, adhigatan'ti attho.

examples.text: api ca me tvaṃ, bhaddāli, dīgharattaṃ cetasā cetoparicca vidito, na c'āyaṃ moghapuriso mayā dhamme desiyamāne aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi katvā sabbacetaso samannāharitvā ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇātī'ti.
cetopariccañāṇañ'ca, sotadhātu visodhitā, iddhī'pi me sacchikatā, patto me āsavakkhayo, chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan'ti.

27126.meaning1: reading the mind; encompassing the mind

examples.text: n'eva pubbenivāsāya, na'pi dibbassa cakkhuno, cetopariyāya iddhiyā, cutiyā upapattiyā, sotadhātuvisuddhiyā, paṇidhī me na vijjati.

27127.meaning1: understanding others' minds; knowing another's thoughts
27127.meaning2: understanding the ways of others' thought, encompassing of mind (with mind)
27127.commentary: (PMa) cetopariyañāṇan'ti ettha pariyātī'ti pariyaṃ, paricchindatī'ti attho. cetaso pariyaṃ cetopariyaṃ, cetopariyañ'ca taṃ ñāṇañ'cā'ti cetopariyañāṇaṃ.

examples.text: cetopariyañāṇañ'ca, sotadhātu visodhitā, iddhī'pi me sacchikatā, patto me āsavakkhayo, cha me'bhiññā sacchikatā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan'ti.

27129.meaning1: reading the mind; encompassing the mind (of)

examples.text: vīmaṃsakena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā parassa cetopariyāyaṃ ajānantena tathāgate samannesanā kātabbā sammāsambuddho vā no vā iti viññāṇāyā'ti.

27130.meaning1: skilled in mind-reading; expert in encompassing (another's) mind

examples.text: tevijjā iddhipattā ca, cetopariyāyakovidā, khīṇ'āsavā arahanto, bahū buddhassa sāvakā'ti.

27131.meaning1: knowledge obtained by encompassing the mind of another
27131.meaning2: knowledge obtained by encompassing the mind of another

examples.text: ettha ca hi te, sāriputta, atīt'ānāgatapaccuppannesu arahantesu sammāsambuddhesu, cetasā cetopariyāyañāṇaṃ n'atthi.

27132.meaning1: train of thought; state of mind; mental process

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato soṇassa cetasā cetoparivitakkam'aññāya… gijjhakūṭe pabbate antarahito sītavane āyasmato soṇassa sammukhe pāturahosi.
atha kho brahmā sahampati bhagavato cetasā cetoparivitakkam'aññāya, seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso samiñjita vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya

27133.meaning1: reading state of mind; understanding train of thought; comprehending (another's) mental processes

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato soṇassa cetasā cetoparivitakkam'aññāya… gijjhakūṭe pabbate antarahito sītavane āyasmato soṇassa sammukhe pāturahosi.

atha khv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, bakassa brahmuno cetasā cetoparivitakkam'aññāya, seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya, evam'eva, ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ subhagavane sālarājamūle antarahito tasmiṃ brahmaloke pāturahosiṃ.

27135.meaning1: due to mental clarity; due to bright mentality

examples.text: yathā haritvā nikkhipeyya, evam'eva tathāvidho, cetopasādahetu hi, sattā gacchanti suggatin'ti.

27136.commentary: (DNa) paresaṃ ceto pharamānā uppajjatī'ti cetopariyapaññā cetopharaṇatā nāma.

examples.text: pañc'aṅgiko sammāsamādhi, pītipharaṇatā, sukhapharaṇatā, cetopharaṇatā, ālokapharaṇatā, paccavekkhaṇanimittaṃ. ime pañca dhammā bhāvetabbā.

27137.meaning1: mental sagacity; being a sage in thought
27137.commentary: (ANa) kāyamunin'ti kāyadvāre muniṃ uttamaṃ parisuddhaṃ, kāyena vā muniṃ. sesadvaye'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: kāyamuniṃ vacīmuniṃ, cetomuniṃ anāsavaṃ, muniṃ moneyyasampannaṃ, āhu sabbappahāyinan'ti.

27138.meaning1: peace of mind; mental stillness; mental serenity; tranquillity of mind
27138.commentary: (ANa) ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassā'ti niyak'ajjhatte appanācittasamādhissa. (ANa) anuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathan'ti niyak'ajjhatte cittasamādhiṃ āsevati bhāveti, samathakammaṭṭhāne yuttappayutto hoti.

examples.text: so tāya dhammapariyattiyā na divasaṃ atināmeti, n'āpi riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, anuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ. evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, bhikkhu dhammavihārī hoti.

ākaṅkheyya ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu, sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo c'assaṃ manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cā'ti, sīlesv'ev'assa paripūrakārī ajjhattaṃ cetosamatham'anuyutto anirākatajjhāno vipassanāya samannāgato brūhetā suññ'āgārānaṃ.

27139.meaning1: devoted to tranquillity of mind; practising internal peace
27139.commentary: (MNa) ajjhattaṃ cetosamatham'anuyutto'ti attano cittasamathe yutto, ettha hi ajjhattan'ti vā attano'ti vā etaṃ ekatthaṃ, byañjanam'eva nānaṃ. bhumm'atthe pan'etaṃ samathan'ti upayogavacanaṃ. anū'ti iminā upasaggena yoge siddhaṃ.

examples.text: ākaṅkheyya ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu, sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca assaṃ manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cā'ti, sīlesv'ev'assa paripūrakārī ajjhattaṃ cetosamatham'anuyutto anirākatajjhāno vipassanāya samannāgato brūhetā suññ'āgārānaṃ.

idh'āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu paṭisallān'ārāmo hoti paṭisallānarato, ajjhattaṃ cetosamatham'anuyutto anirākatajjhāno, vipassanāya samannāgato, brūhetā suññ'āgārānaṃ. evarūpena kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti.

27140.meaning1: proper way conducive to peace of mind; correct course for tranquillity of mind; proper procedure for mental peace

examples.text: cetosamathasāmīciṃ, sikkhamānaṃ sadā sataṃ, satataṃ pahit'atto'ti, āhu bhikkhuṃ tathāvidhan'ti.

27141.meaning1: stability of mind; stillness of mind; meditative composure

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappam'anvāya padhānam'anvāya anuyogam'anvāya appamādam'anvāya sammāmanasikāram'anvāya tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati yathāsamāhite citte anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati
katamo eko dhammo duppaṭivijjho? ānantariko cetosamādhi. ayaṃ eko dhammo duppaṭivijjho.

27142.meaning1: caused by mental contact; produced by mental impressions; born from mind experience

examples.text: tattha katamaṃ domanassaṃ? yaṃ cetasikaṃ asātaṃ, cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ, cetosamphassajaṃ asātaṃ dukkhaṃ vedayitaṃ, cetosamphassajā asātā dukkhā vedanā.

27143.commentary: (MNa) kāyasukhan'ti pañcadvārikasukhaṃ. cetosukhan'ti manodvārikasukhaṃ. ettha ca pañcadvārikajavanena samāpajjanaṃ vā vuṭṭhānaṃ vā n'atthi, uppannamattakam'eva hoti. manodvārikena sabbaṃ hoti. ayañ'ca maggavuṭṭhānassa paccayabhūtā balavavipassanā, sā'pi manodvāriken'eva hoti.

examples.text: tassa kāyikā'pi darathā pahīyanti, cetasikā'pi darathā pahīyanti, kāyikā'pi santāpā pahīyanti, cetasikā'pi santāpā pahīyanti, kāyikā'pi pariḷāhā pahīyanti, cetasikā'pi pariḷāhā pahīyanti. so kāyasukham'pi cetosukham'pi paṭisaṃvedeti.
kāyasuciṃ vacīsuciṃ, cetosuciṃ anāsavaṃ, suciṃ soceyyasampannaṃ, āhu ninhātapāpakan'ti.

27145.meaning1: who has attained mental mastery; in control of one's mind
27145.commentary: (ANa) cetovasippatto'ti cittavasībhāvaṃ patto. evarūpo khīṇ'āsavo hoti, idha pana anāgāmī kathito. (ANa) iddhimā cetovasippatto'ti iddhisampanno cittassa vasibhāvapatto khīṇ'āsavo.

examples.text: yo ve kilesāni pahāya pañca, paripuṇṇasekho aparihānadhammo, cetovasippatto samāhit'indriyo, sa ve ṭhit'atto'ti naro pavuccati.

tassa tattha na h'eva kho sukhino dhammapadā plavanti, api ca kho bhikkhu iddhimā cetovasippatto devaparisāyaṃ dhammaṃ deseti. tassa evaṃ hoti, ayaṃ vā so dhammavinayo, yatth'āhaṃ pubbe brahmacariyaṃ acarin'ti.

27146.meaning1: beneficial for managing the mind; conducive to mental investigation

examples.text: yā ca kho ayaṃ, ānanda, kathā abhisallekhikā cetovicāraṇasappāyā ek'antanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati

27148.commentary: (MNt) cetovinīvaraṇasappāyā'ti kusalacitt'uppattiyā nivārakānaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ dūrībhāvakaraṇena cetovinīvaraṇasaṅkhātānaṃ samathavipassanānaṃ sappāyā. samathavipassanā-cittass'eva vā vibhūtibhāvakaraṇāya sappāyā upakārikā'ti cetovinīvaraṇasappāyā.

examples.text: yā ca kho ayaṃ, ānanda, kathā abhisallekhikā cetovinīvaraṇasappāyā ek'antanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati

27149.commentary: (MNt) so cetovimutto nāmā'ti so ariyo cetovimutto nāma hoti.

examples.text: yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cetovimutto ca hoti paññāvimutto ca hoti, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ukkhittapaligho iti'pi, saṃkiṇṇaparikho iti'pi, abbūḷh'esiko iti'pi, niraggaḷo iti'pi, ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto iti'pi.

27150.meaning1: mental liberation; emancipation of heart; (comm) samadhi obtained from fruition
27150.commentary: (ANa) rāgavirāgā cetovimuttī'ti rāgassa khayavirāgena cetovimutti nāma hoti. phalasamādhiss'etaṃ nāmaṃ. (DNa) akuppā cetovimuttī'ti arahattaphalavimutti.

examples.text: akuppā cetovimutti etadattham'idaṃ brāhmaṇa brahmacariyaṃ

khattiyakulā ce'pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti. so ca āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati. āsavānaṃ khayā samaṇo hoti.

27151.commentary: (MNa) cetovimutti parihāyī'ti ettha cetovimutti nāma araññe vasissāmā'ti uppann'ājjhāsayo, so parihāyī'ti attho.

examples.text: tesaṃ gimhānaṃ pacchime māse, tiṇ'odakasaṅkhaye, adhimattakasimānaṃ patto kāyo hoti. tesaṃ adhimattakasimānaṃ pattakāyānaṃ balavīriyaṃ parihāyi. balavīriye parihīne cetovimutti parihāyi.

27152.meaning1: with mental liberation as fruit; resulting in emancipation of heart
27152.commentary: (MNa) phalakkhaṇe nibbattā cetovimutti phalaṃ assā'ti cetovimuttiphalā. tadeva cetovimuttisaṅkhātaṃ phalaṃ ānisaṃso assā'ti cetovimuttiphal'ānisaṃsā.

examples.text: katihi pan'āvuso, aṅgehi anuggahitā sammādiṭṭhi cetovimuttiphalā ca hoti cetovimuttiphal'ānisaṃsā ca, paññāvimuttiphalā ca hoti paññāvimuttiphal'ānisaṃsā cā'ti?

27153.meaning1: with mental liberation as fruit and benefit; with emancipation of heart as result and advantage
27153.commentary: (MNa) phalakkhaṇe nibbattā cetovimutti phalaṃ assā'ti cetovimuttiphalā. tadeva cetovimuttisaṅkhātaṃ phalaṃ ānisaṃso assā'ti cetovimuttiphal'ānisaṃsā.

examples.text: katihi pan'āvuso, aṅgehi anuggahitā sammādiṭṭhi cetovimuttiphalā ca hoti cetovimuttiphal'ānisaṃsā ca, paññāvimuttiphalā ca hoti paññāvimuttiphal'ānisaṃsā cā'ti?

27154.meaning1: accomplished in mental liberation; endowed with emancipation of heart

examples.text: cetovimuttisampannā, atho paññāvimuttiyā, bhabbā te antakiriyāya, na te jātijarūpagā'ti.

27155.meaning1: devoid of mental liberation; lacking emancipation of heart
27155.commentary: (SNPa) cetovimuttihīnā te, atho paññāvimuttiyā'ti ettha arahattaphalasamādhi rāgavirāgā cetovimutti, arahattaphalapaññā avijjāvirāgā paññāvimuttī'ti veditabbā.

examples.text: tañ'ca maggaṃ na jānanti, dukkh'ūpasamagāminaṃ, cetovimuttihīnā te, atho paññāvimuttiyā, abhabbā te antakiriyāya, te ve jātijar'ūpagā.
eso ce, bhante, maggo esā paṭipadā pañcannaṃ oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya, atha kiñ'carahi idh'ekacce bhikkhū cetovimuttino ekacce bhikkhū paññāvimuttino'ti?

27157.meaning1: skilled in the expansion of mind
27157.commentary: (ANt) ceto'ti c'ettha cittasīsena samādhi vutto, tasmā cetaso samādhissa vivaṭṭanaṃ cetovivaṭṭo, ekasmiṃ'y'ev'ārammaṇe samādhicittaṃ vivaṭṭetvā heṭṭhimassa heṭṭhimassa upar'ūpari hāpanato rūp'āvacarajjhānalābhī cetovivaṭṭakusalo nāma.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ cetovivaṭṭakusalānaṃ yadidaṃ cūḷapanthako.

27158.meaning1: conducive to opening the heart; beneficial for revealing the mind

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu y'āyaṃ kathā abhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā… evarūpiyā kathāya nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
telappadīpo c'ettha jhāyeyya, catasso ca pajāpatiyo manāpamanāpena paccupaṭṭhitā assu. taṃ kiṃ maññasi, kumāra, sukhaṃ vā so sayeyya no vā? kathaṃ vā te ettha hotī'ti?
sace te, bhaggava, agaru viharemu āvesane ekarattan'ti. na kho me, bhante, garu. atthi c'ettha pabbajito paṭhamaṃ vās'ūpagato. sace so anujānāti, viharatha, bhante, yathāsukhan'ti.

27160.meaning1: and here; and in this case
27160.commentary: (THIa) n'atthi c'ettha dhuvaṃ ṭhitī'ti etasmiṃ dhane dhuvabhāvo ca ṭhitibhāvo ca n'atthi, cañcalam'anavaṭṭhitam'evā'ti attho.

examples.text: lobhanaṃ madanañ'c'etaṃ, mohanaṃ rajavaḍḍhanaṃ, sāsaṅkaṃ bahuāyāsaṃ, n'atthi c'ettha dhuvaṃ ṭhiti.
bahuṃ ve saraṇaṃ yanti, pabbatāni vanāni ca, ārāmarukkhacetyāni, manussā bhayatajjitā.
ārāmacetyā vanacetyā, pokkharañño sunimmitā, manussarāmaṇeyyassa, kalaṃ n'āgghanti soḷasiṃ.
kusalaṃ, bhikkhave, bhāvetha. sakkā, bhikkhave, kusalaṃ bhāvetuṃ. no ce'daṃ, bhikkhave, sakkā abhavissa kusalaṃ bhāvetuṃ, n'āhaṃ evaṃ vadeyyaṃ, kusalaṃ, bhikkhave, bhāvethā'ti.
saddhā dutiyā purisassa hoti, paññā c'enaṃ pasāsati, nibbān'ābhirato macco, sabbadukkhā pamuccatī'ti.
appaṃ vata jīvitaṃ idaṃ, oraṃ vassasatā'pi miyyati, yo ce'pi aticca jīvati, atha kho so jarasā'pi miyyati.
ettako ce'pi, bhikkhu, attabhāvapaṭilābho abhavissa nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, na'y'idaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammā dukkhakkhayāya.
cel'aṇḍukena ce'pi sabrahmacārī āyasmantaṃ puṇṇaṃ mantāṇiputtaṃ muddhanā pariharantā labheyyuṃ dassanāya, labheyyuṃ payirūpāsanāya, tesam'pi lābhā tesam'pi suladdhaṃ
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ādittacelo vā ādittasīso vā, tass'eva celassa vā sīsassa vā nibbāpanāya adhimattaṃ chandañ'ca vāyāmañ'ca ussāhañ'ca ussoḷhiñ'ca appaṭivāniñ'ca satiñ'ca sampajaññañ'ca kareyya.

27167.commentary: (ANa) celakā'ti ye yuddhe jayaddhajaṃ gahetvā purato gacchanti.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahubalakāyo paṭivasati, seyyath'idaṃ, hatth'ārohā ass'ārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyakā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsakaputtā.

27169.meaning1: cloth pad; pad placed on the head for carrying heavy items
27169.commentary: (MNa) celaṇḍupakenā'ti ettha celaṃ vuccati vatthaṃ, aṇḍupakaṃ cumbaṭakaṃ. vatthacumbaṭakaṃ sīse katvā

examples.text: cel'aṇḍukena ce'pi sabrahmacārī āyasmantaṃ puṇṇaṃ mantāṇiputtaṃ muddhanā pariharantā labheyyuṃ dassanāya, labheyyuṃ payirūpāsanāya, tesam'pi lābhā tesam'pi suladdhaṃ
atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ apalokesi. atha kho āyasmā ānando bodhiṃ rājakumāraṃ etadavoca, saṃharatu, rājakumāra, dussāni, na bhagavā celapaṭikaṃ akkamissati.
upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato sarīraṃ naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkarontā garuṃ karontā mānentā pūjentā celavitānāni karontā maṇḍalamāḷe paṭiyādentā ekadivasaṃ vītināmesuṃ.

examples.text: samaṇo kho daharo'ti na uññātabbo na paribhotabbo. daharo'pi c'esa samaṇo gotamo mah'iddhiko hoti mah'ānubhāvo, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ime pañhe puccheyyan'ti.

27178.synonym: imañca, etañca, cidaṃ, cimaṃ, cetaṃ, ceso, panesā

27179.synonym: imañca, etañca, cidaṃ, cimaṃ, cetaṃ, cesa, panesā

examples.text: te evaṃ vadeyyuṃ m'āyasmanto etaṃ bhikkhuṃ kiñci avacuttha, dhammavādī c'eso bhikkhu, vinayavādī c'eso bhikkhu, amhākañ'c'eso bhikkhu chandañ'ca ruciñ'ca ādāya voharati
sabhayo c'eso maggo sappaṭibhayo ca sakaṇṭako ca sagahano ca ummaggo ca kummaggo ca duhitiko ca. asappurisasevito c'eso maggo, na c'eso maggo sappurisehi sevito.
so paṭisaṃharati c'eva na ca vitakketi na ca vicāreti
sandiṭṭhiyā c'eva vīvadātā, saṃsuddhapaññā kusalā mutīmā, na tesaṃ koci parihīnapañño, diṭṭhī hi tesam'pi tathā samattā.
paññā c'eva sati yañ'ca nāmarūpañ'ca mārisa, etaṃ me puṭṭho pabrūhi, katth'etaṃ uparujjhati.
na hi pana taṃ, gahapati, paṭibhāsi bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ paṭipucchituṃ, kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, āturakāyo c'eva hoti āturacitto ca, kittāvatā ca pana āturakāyo hi kho hoti no ca āturacitto'ti?
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, saradasamaye thullaphusitake deve vassante udake udakabubbuḷaṃ uppajjati c'eva nirujjhati ca.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ ujjāletukāmo assa. so tattha allāni c'eva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya, allāni ca gomayāni pakkhipeyya, allāni ca kaṭṭhāni pakkhipeyya
sappāyāni c'eva bhojanāni bhuñjeyyāsi, mā te asappāyāni bhojanāni bhuñjato vaṇo assāvī assa.
atha ca pana tvaṃ, moghapurisa, attanā duggahitena amhe c'eva abbhācikkhasi, attānañ'ca khanasi, bahuñ'ca apuññaṃ pasavasi. tañ'hi te, moghapurisa, bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā'ti.

27184.meaning1: and his alone; but just his

examples.text: jayaṃ ve maññati bālo, vācāya pharusaṃ bhaṇaṃ, jayañ'c'ev'assa taṃ hoti, yā titikkhā vijānato.

27185.meaning1: and just of this; and exactly of this

examples.text: maṃ ce'pi tumhe, bhikkhave, etam'atthaṃ paṭipuccheyyātha, aham'pi taṃ evam'evaṃ byākareyyaṃ yathā taṃ ānandena byākataṃ. eso c'ev'etassa attho. evañ'ca naṃ dhāreyyāthā'ti.

27186.meaning1: and now here; and in this regard just

examples.text: upamā kho my'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, katā atthassa viññāpanāya. ayaṃ c'ev'ettha attho, samatittiko telapatto'ti kho, bhikkhave, kāyagatāya etaṃ satiyā adhivacanaṃ.
ayaṃ c'ev'ettha attho, cattāro āsīvisā uggatejā ghoravisā'ti kho, bhikkhave, catunn'etaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ adhivacanaṃ

27188.meaning2: banana juice; drink made from bananas

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno codakaṃ'y'eva paṭippharati, kiṃ nu kho tuyhaṃ bālassa abyattassa bhaṇitena!
codakena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā paraṃ codetu'kāmena pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ paccavekkhitvā pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā paro codetabbo

27190.commentary: (SNa) codako'ti vatthusmiṃ otiṇṇe vā anotiṇṇe vā vītikkamaṃ disvā, āvuso, bhikkhunā nāma evaṃ nivāsetabbaṃ, evaṃ pārupitabbaṃ, evaṃ gantabbaṃ, evaṃ ṭhātabbaṃ, evaṃ nisīditabbaṃ, evaṃ khāditabbaṃ, evaṃ bhuñjitabban'ti tantivasena anusiṭṭhiṃ deti.

examples.text: āraddhavīriyo, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto. vattā, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto. vacanakkhamo, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto. codako, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto. pāpagarahī, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto.
idaṃ me, bhante, cīvaraṃ atirekatikkhattuṃ codanāya atirekachakkhattuṃ ṭhānena abhinipphāditaṃ nissaggiyaṃ. im'āhaṃ saṅghassa nissajjāmī'ti
ayaṃ kho, lohicca, paṭhamo satthā, yo loke codanā-araho, yo ca pan'evarūpaṃ satthāraṃ codeti, sā codanā bhūtā tacchā dhammikā anavajjā.

27193.commentary: (MNa) na codanāya taritabban'ti na codan'atthāya vegāyitabbaṃ. ekacco hi puggalo nalāṭe te sāsapamattā piḷakā'ti vutto mayhaṃ nalāṭe sāsapamattaṃ piḷakaṃ passasi, attano nalāṭe tālapakkamattaṃ mahāgaṇḍaṃ na passasī'ti vadati. tasmā puggalo upaparikkhitabbo.

examples.text: tesañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ siyā aññatarassa bhikkhuno āpatti siyā vītikkamo, tatra, bhikkhave, na codanāya taritabbaṃ.

27194.commentary: (DNa) na codan'āraho'ti ayañ'hi yasmā paṭhamam'eva attānaṃ patirūpe patiṭṭhāpetvā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti. sāvakā c'assa assavā hutvā yath'ānusiṭṭhaṃ paṭipajjanti, tāya ca paṭipattiyā mahantaṃ visesam'adhigacchanti. tasmā na codan'āraho'ti.

examples.text: tayo kho'me, lohicca, satthāro, ye loke codan'ārahā, yo ca pan'evarūpe satthāro codeti, sā codanā bhūtā tacchā dhammikā anavajjā.

27196.meaning1: grounds for accusation; basis for reprimand

examples.text: tīṇi codanāvatthūni, diṭṭhena, sutena, parisaṅkāya.
attanā coday'attānaṃ, paṭimaṃsetha attanā, so attagutto satimā, sukhaṃ bhikkhu vihāhisi.
ujumaggamhi akkhāte, gacchatha mā nivattatha, attanā coday'attānaṃ, nibbānam'abhihāraye.
dvattikkhattuṃ codayamāno sārayamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya, icc'etaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce abhinipphādeyya, catukkhattuṃ pañcakkhattuṃ chakkhattu'paramaṃ tuṇhībhūtena uddissa ṭhātabbaṃ
